Start date: 1883-09-02  
Subtract 27 weeks = 189 days (27 × 7).  
Add 5 days → total subtract 194 days.  

1883 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Days in Aug 1883 = 31, July = 31, June = 30, May = 31, April = 30, March = 31, February = 28.  

Back from 1883-09-02:  
September 2 minus 2 days → Aug 31.  
August has 31 days: Aug 31 minus 31 days → July 31.  
July 31 minus 31 days → June 30.  
June 30 minus 30 days → May 31.  
May 31 minus 31 days → April 30.  
April 30 minus 30 days → March 31.  
March 31 minus 31 days → February 28.  

Total days subtracted so far: 2+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 186 days.  
Need 194 days total, so 8 more days back from Feb 28 → February 20.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1883-02-20
